title: Are we within IPMA's terms on launch day? Non-profit, the notice it asks for, its logo
summary: Three things bear on whether the site is within IPMA's terms when it launches. (1) Say whether this site is non-profit in the sense of IPMA's terms ("finalidades lucrativas"): free use of its data is allowed only then. (2) IPMA asks users of its API to write to it saying they use the service and why: a draft is ready (agents/ipma/ipma-api-notice.md); a person sends it. (3) IPMA's terms want its logo beside its data on web pages; we print "Source: IPMA" in words: say whether the logo goes on.
closes: Your answer on non-profit; the notice sent by a person; your word on the logo.
blocks: How far the IPMA section you asked for at 02:10 may reuse IPMA's data.
